review_candidates.title: Training Customer Support Specialist
review_candidates.description: About McKinney-Vento.org McKinney-Vento.org (MV Learning, LLC) provides training and software to the people in US school districts responsible for supporting students experiencing homelessness. Under the federal McKinney-Vento Act, every district has a designated liaison for these students, and our platform gives those liaisons the training, tools, and workflows they need to identify students, meet compliance requirements, and get kids the support they are entitled to. We work with school districts across the country, through direct district partnerships and through state and regional agreements that open our training to every district in the area. We are a small, close-knit team, and the work matters: the faster a district is up and running, the sooner its students get help. The role We are hiring a Training Customer Support Specialist to make sure the districts we already work with actually get value from what they have. Here is the problem you will own. A district signs on, or gains access through a state or regional partnership, and then nothing happens. The liaison is busy, may not realize what they have access to, and often does not respond to email. In our experience, once we reach them by phone, they are glad we called and happy to get started. Your job is to be that call. You will work from our “at risk” lists: districts that have not yet onboarded, and districts that have onboarded but whose staff are not completing training at the level we would like. You will reach out to them one by one, mostly by phone and also by email and Zoom, walk them step by step through onboarding, answer questions about our products, and help them get their liaisons trained. When something needs fixing or a question is beyond your scope, you coordinate with our Launch team and Account Manager to get it resolved. This is not a sales role. Every conversation you have is with an existing client. It is about retention, adoption, and making sure the people we serve get what they are already entitled to. The rhythm of the role follows the school year. Renewals and fiscal-year openings (around July 1) and the start of the school year are busy; other stretches are quieter, and we expect you to use that time with autonomy, improving materials, cleaning up data, and getting ahead on outreach. What you will do Outbound outreach to at-risk districts. Work daily through our lists of districts that have not onboarded or are under-using their training, primarily by phone, supported by email and Zoom. Run onboarding. Schedule and lead onboarding meetings over Zoom, and guide liaisons step by step through registration, account setup, and getting their staff into the training. Provide training and product support. Answer questions about our products and services, demonstrate features, and help clients get unstuck. Monitor training success. Pull and send monthly training success reports to the districts we work with, spot districts that are falling behind, and act on red flags early. Follow up on self-registration. Send reminders and check in with districts that chose to self-register but have not completed the process. Coordinate internally. Work closely with the Launch team and Account Manager to resolve issues, escalate questions, and keep client records and notes current in our systems. Improve the process. Keep outreach scripts, email templates, and onboarding guides current, and tell us what is and is not working. Flex with the seasons. Help where the team needs it most during quieter periods, which may include light outreach support for the account management team. What we are looking for Excellent spoken and written English. You will spend most of your day on the phone and in email with US school district staff, and you need to be clear, warm, and professional in both. Comfortable on the phone. You are happy to pick up the phone and call someone who has not replied to three emails, and you can turn a cold reception into a productive conversation. Patient, friendly, and persistent. Our clients are busy educators. You can explain the same thing many times without losing your enthusiasm, and you do not give up after one unanswered call. Organized and self-directed. You can manage a long list of districts, keep accurate notes, follow up on time, and stay productive without someone looking over your shoulder. Comfortable with software. You can learn a web platform well enough to teach it, and you are at ease with Zoom, email and Google docs. A problem-solver. When a client hits a wall, you figure out whether you can solve it, and if not, who can, and you follow it through to resolution. Reliable availability Monday to Friday, 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM US Eastern. 2+ years of experience in customer success, client onboarding, training, support, or a similar client-facing role. Bonus points Experience working with US K-12 schools, school districts, or education-sector clients Experience onboarding or training customers on a SaaS or LMS product Experience with HubSpot or a similar CRM Familiarity with the McKinney-Vento Act or student homelessness programs Why McKinney-Vento.org Work that matters. Every district you get onboarded means students experiencing homelessness get identified and supported sooner. A small team where you are seen. You will work directly with the people running the business, and your feedback will shape how we do things. Training and support. We will train you thoroughly on our products and services, and set monthly goals together as a team. Fully remote , with a predictable Monday to Friday schedule. Accrued paid time off and additional paid holidays.  McKinney-Vento.org asks respectfully to only apply through the application form and not email/apply to them directly. Recruiters and Agencies please do not contact McKinney-Vento.org directly.

review_candidates.description: 该职位来源于猎聘 职责描述: 【定位】 开发面向汽车及汽车零部件制造领域的轮式双臂机器人，主要用于物料搬运与拾放作业，有效载荷约 10–15 公斤，生产节拍需与现有生产工艺相匹配。 带领广州硬件团队——机械、电气、嵌入式、控制、集成与测试。全面负责机器人本体：轮式底盘、双臂关节模组、执行器、电源、感知与整机集成，从对标拆解、自研设计到量产交付，最终在客户产线现场落地运行。 核心能力 1.硬件架构与技术路线：负责机器人硬件整体架构设计、技术路线选型与关键方案评审，对性能、成本、可靠性与合规性（电磁兼容、安规）负总责。 2.系统集成能力：以驱动、传动、传感、控制一体化设计为目标，跨学科统筹机械、电磁、硬件、控制与测试工程师，解决高精度装配、线束布局、传感器标定及热管理、低噪音等技术瓶颈。 3.测试与可靠性体系：规划硬件测试策略、可靠性方案（DVP）与电磁兼容及环境测试方案，定义硬件验收指标，并通过团队推动问题闭环；工作重心在测试体系规划与验收标准定义，而非亲自执行全部测试用例。 4.项目与风险管理：对接机械、软件、算法、生产与测试，主导硬件端项目推进，识别硬件风险点并推动转产，解决批量生产重大硬件问题；主导重大硬件故障根因复盘，推动设计迭代优化。 5.团队建设与规范沉淀：负责硬件研发团队搭建、人员分工、任务排期与技术指导；建立硬件设计规范、器件库与评审规范，输出硬件知识库，沉淀机器人硬件平台。 6.供应链协同能力：管理关键供应商的技术评估与改进，确保零部件质量与供应稳定；优化物料清单成本，完成器件选型与面向制造的设计优化（DFM），推动产品从研发样机稳定量产。 7.工业现场适配能力：确保硬件满足工厂现场要求——物料搬运的节拍与连续作业占空比指标、产线粉尘与电磁环境适应性，以及与产线人员协同作业的安全合规要求。 优先条件 1.具备机器人硬件平台量产经验（移动操作、轮式双臂、工业或协作机器人）优先 2.主导过机器人关节模组从 0 到 1 的开发，精通高扭矩密度、低转动惯量、轻量化、热管理与低噪音设计者优先。 3.参与过结构件工艺评审、模具开发、样品验证与产能爬坡；熟悉各类机械加工、装配与表面处理工艺。 4.熟悉机器人动力学，能结合运动学与动力学模型开展结构刚柔耦合仿真分析（ANSYS、ABAQUS、SolidWorks Simulation）者优先。 5.具备从 0 到 1 组建硬件研发组织的经验：团队与流程搭建，并同步搭建供应链。 6.具备面向工业物料搬运的移动操作或轮式双臂平台经验，包括 10–15 公斤级载荷的耐久性设计与连续作业可靠性者优先。 7.熟悉汽车行业质量与过程标准（APQP/PPAP、IATF 16949 或同等标准）及产线集成要求者优先。 任职资格: 1.机械工程、电气工程、机电一体化、自动化或相关专业本科及以上学历，硕士优先。 2.移动操作、轮式双臂、工业或协作机器人领域 5 年以上硬件研发经验，其中 2 年以上硬件团队管理经验。 3.主导过至少一个完整机器人硬件项目：需求定义、方案设计、样机开发、可靠性验证（DVP）到量产交付的全流程。 4.深入理解机器人关节模组：熟悉电机、谐波与行星减速器、编码器、力矩传感器与驱动器的选型与集成，具备主导并统筹现场装配、调试与问题排查的能力。 5.熟悉电源系统、电机驱动（磁场定向控制）、传感、电磁兼容及安规等合规设计；了解轮式底盘传动与电池系统设计。 6.具备物料清单成本管控与供应商管理经验，能主导器件风险评估与供应商技术评审。

review_candidates.title: Orthophoniste
review_candidates.description: Descriptif du poste Le GCSMS Handicap d'un contient à l'autre recrute pour son équipe mobile TND de l'enfant intoxiqué aux métaux lourds en communes isolées de Guyane un.e orthophoniste. Aux côtés d'un infirmier coordinateur, d'une neuropsychologue, d'une psychomotricienne et d'une médiatrice en santé, vous interviendrez dans la prise en charge de TND auprès d 'enfants de Camopi et Trois-Sauts en pleine forêt amazonienne. Nombreux déplacements à prévoir (au moins une semaine par mois) Dans le cadre de vos missions : Bilans de troubles des apprentissages et du neurodéveloppement, participer aux ateliers de remédiation collectives, concevoir et diffuser des outils de sensibilisation, aider à l'adaptation culturelle et linguistique des batteries de bilan (projet de recherche porté avec le CHU de Guyane) Votre expertise nous permettra de dresser un bilan de territoire pour le développement du dispositif. Votre profil : souhait de questionner ses pratiques en milieu interculturel riche, adaptable aux conditions particulière d'exercice (plurilinguisme, multiculturalité, langue maternelle non française...) Poste en temps plein Convention 66 + 20% prime de vie chère Cette annonce vous intrigue ? Voici un extrait de la fiche de poste : Missions du service Pilakit est chargé de prendre la suite de la mission EMLO, pôle des Centre Délocalisés de Proximité de Santé (CDPS) du CHU de Guyane qui assure le diagnostic (dosage de plombémie) et le traitement somatique du saturnisme à Camopi et Trois-Sauts en réalisant des bilans des troubles du neurodéveloppement en lien avec l’imprégnation au plomb. Pilakit a pour mission : De réaliser des bilans TND : à Camopi et à Trois-Sauts. Proposer une prise en charge spécifique adaptée aux patients intoxiqués au plomb et/ou au mercure. D’évaluer les modes d’interventions possibles dans le contexte des communes de l’intérieur ; Mener des actions de sensibilisation auprès des partenaires, et de la population Missions de l'orthophoniste L’orthophoniste contribue au développement de la communication, du langage oral et écrit, et des fonctions de la sphère oro-faciale des enfants accueillis. Il/elle évalue les besoins, met en place et adapte les prises en charge individuelles ou groupales, en lien avec le projet personnalisé. Il/elle soutient l’accès aux apprentissages et à la socialisation, en collaboration étroite avec l’équipe pluridisciplinaire, les familles et les partenaires scolaires. Activités Les missions s'articuleront autour des axes suivants: Réalisation : réaliser des bilans d’orthophonie auprès d'enfants âgés de 3 à 18 ans présentant des troubles du neurodéveloppement, consécutifs à une intoxication aux métaux lourds. Évaluation orthophonique : réaliser des bilans complets et adaptés à la population cible, incluant des tests standardisés. Les évaluations devront tenir compte des spécificités de l'intoxication aux métaux lourds et des contextes socioculturels. Les bilans demandés concernent les troubles de l’apprentissage et de l’oralité. Diagnostic : formuler des diagnostics précis et détaillés sur la nature et la sévérité des troubles du neurodéveloppement. Ces diagnostics seront rédigés sous forme de constat clinique. Recommandations : Établir des recommandations personnalisées pour la prise en charge de enfants, incluant des stratégies thérapeutiques, éducatives et des adaptations environnementales. Travailler sur la recherche en adaptation des bilans aux contextes culturels et linguistiques. Participer à l’élaboration du projet de remédiation auprès des enfants bilantés. Collaboration : Travailler en étroite collaboration avec l’équipe mobile métaux lourds (EMLo) du CHU de Guyane, les Centres Délocalisés de Prévention et de Santé, les familles, les enseignants et les autres professionnels intervenant auprès des enfants. Reporting : Rédiger des comptes rendus d'évaluation de l’activité, participer à la veille scientifique U-Stramélo. Missions itinérantes : Effectuer des déplacements réguliers sur les communes de l'intérieur de la Guyane, impliquant une grande autonomie et une capacité d'adaptation à des contextes variés. Gestion administrative : Assurer la gestion administrative de ses interventions (planification des visites, saisie des données, etc.). Concevoir, proposer et adapter des supports et outils de communication (pictogrammes, CAA, gestes, etc.). Accompagner les enseignants dans l’aménagement des supports pédagogiques et l’accessibilité des apprentissages. Contribuer à l’accompagnement des familles : conseils, guidance parentale, suivi des progrès et relais des stratégies de communication. Participer aux réunions de coordination, de synthèse et de suivi des projets. Assurer un rôle de sensibilisation et de formation auprès des partenaires. Rédaction des comptes rendus, bilans et documents nécessaires au suivi de l’enfant, conformément aux exigences du cahier des charges. Profil recherché Expérience dans les évaluations de TND chez l'enfant souhaitée Connaissance des troubles du langage, de la communication, de la cognition Maîtrise des approches pédagogiques et thérapeutiques adaptées aux enfants Capacité à évaluer les besoins et compétences des enfants et à concevoir des programmes individualisés Aptitude au travail en équipe pluridisciplinaire (enseignants spécialisés, éducateurs, psychologues, familles) Qualités relationnelles, patience, écoute, sens de l’observation et posture bienveillante Rigueur, autonomie, organisation et capacité à prioriser les interventions Aisance rédactionnelle et maîtrise des outils informatiques professionnels Capacité à participer à la réflexion institutionnelle et à la démarche qualité Diplôme d’État d’Orthophoniste exigé Point d'attention : Notre dispositif Pilakit est en phase de développement, ce qui implique une grande liberté dans l'expression de son exercice professionnel mais exige une capacité de questionner ses pratiques et de s'adapter à de nombreuses containtes. Intérêt du poste : Possibilité d'envisager un travail de recherche en collaboration avec les équipes du CHU et de l'Université de Guayne. Merci d'envoyer vos CV et lettre de motivation à Christophe WECKER, c.wecker@gcsms-handicap.org a.croize@gcsms-handicap.org

review_candidates.description: Somos uma empresa sólida, líder no mercado de engrenagens e temos o orgulho da nossa tecnologia de ponta e da oportunidade de poder contribuir com o seu desenvolvimento profissional. Com 48 anos de fundação em Pernambuco e 88 anos de Brasil, a Musashi do Brasil Ltda vem cada vez mais consolidado sua marca no mercado automotivo. Instalada inicialmente no estado de São Paulo em 1935, como Indústria Mecânica Gardony S.A, teve em 1975 o início das operações da unidade fabril de Igarassu (PE), cuja razão social era Motogear Norte Indústria de Engrenagens S.A. Em 1997, o grupo Musashi contribuiu para o processo de expansão e modernização da empresa no Brasil e tem orgulho de poder dar continuidade ao empreendimento passando-se a razão Musashi do Brasil Ltda. >>> O Pensamento do Fundador Simplicidade e Resistência Sinceridade e Consistência A Musashi do Brasil destina-se a fabricação de engrenagens para o ramo de duas e quatro rodas (automotivo). Os produtos principais são: 2 Rodas: engrenagens de câmbio e extra-câmbio, coroas, catracas, pinhão, disco de freio e eixo balanceiro; 4 Rodas: engrenagens bevel gear. >>> O que esperamos de você: Ensino médico completo e conhecimento em Metrologia. >>> Como você vai contribuir: ' Operando equipamento de produção em série; ' Fazendo o controle de qualidade visual e aferir as medidas de peças no processo produtivo, usando parâmetro para os padrões especificados no processo - paquímetro, calibre, micrômetro, entre outros, aprovando-as (OK) ou segregando-as (NG), devendo selecioná-las em lotes; ' Encaixando as peças nas máquinas; ' Mantendo seus equipamentos em boas condições; ' Cuidando da conservação e limpeza das máquinas e peças, checagem visual para certificar-se da qualidade obtida, além de verificar itens de segurança; ' Participando de tarefas que requeiram o uso de bancada e ferramentas manuais; ' Cumprindo os procedimentos de uso adequado e conservação das instalações, equipamentos, ferramental, dispositivos, instrumentos de medição, EPI's e atividades de 5S, MPT; ' Registrar no MSQD todas e quaisquer alterações que afetem o processo produtivo; ' Cumprir com os procedimentos do Sistema da Qualidade e Meio Ambiente e Segurança nas áreas em que atua. >>> Jonada de Trabalho: 42,5 horas semanais Nosso time vem crescendo e se você é antenado e gosta de trabalhar com qualidade e precisão, essa oportunidade pode ser sua! Esperamos você para nos ajudar a construir sonhos! Ficou interessado (a)? Venha fazer parte desta equipe! Go Far Beyond! review_candidates.title: Manufacturing Engineer P3
review_candidates.description: Descripción de la empresa It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive . As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care , our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion —have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide. We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world. The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life. If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare , you’ll find your purpose here. Descripción del empleo Primary Function Of Position Contribute your leadership and technical skills in the areas of equipment engineering and manufacturing process technologies, problem-solving, training, and project management in a growing medical device company. In this key role, you will be the driving force behind Lean tool implementation and continuous improvement projects site-wide. Your combination of training, motivational skills, analytical problem-solving ability, and passion for Lean manufacturing will be just the right fit for the manufacturing environment of precision instruments for minimally invasive robotic surgery. This position is highly collaborative, and strong communication/presentation skills will provide you with high visibility amongst the engineering, production and management teams. Essential Job Duties Manufacturing responsibility for tooling/fixtures, manufacturing equipment, and design improvements production. Evaluate and challenge mechanism designs for reliability, functionality, and manufacturability. Provide suggested change proposals. Work in a close collaboration with multiple departments and inter sites across all the company. Seeking better and more suitable technologies for improving production processes. Knowledge and experience of IQOQPQ equipment and process execution. Design, document, and create an efficient “High-volume’ manufacturing assembly line including: Workplace and flow process development. Specify, document, procure, repair, maintain, qualify, and implement fixtures, hand tools, and equipment. Determine and incorporate critical feature inspection and test checkpoints into the process. Document if discrepancies, actions or steps are required. Supporting the teaching and training of other team members to develop the needed skills and knowledge in specialized equipment and processes including but not limited to diagnosing, repairing, maintaining, calibrating, or any other related to manufacturing processes. Approve design releases to manufacturing, review engineering documentation, and provide vendor and in-house DFM inputs. Review/approve and determine the impact of ECOs from manufacturing and field perspectives. Take responsibility for developing and maintaining compliance with the quality system. Update and revise Manufacturing Process Instructions (MPIs) to ensure accuracy and completeness. Utilize knowledge of assembly/parts, suppliers, mfg and test processes. Execute complex DMR/DHR, BOM, and traveler document changes with little oversight. Address line support issues as they arise. Document and report any variances, problems, issues, or concerns on all aspects of the manufacturing process. Provide production personnel with expectations and performance feedback regularly in the production process. Drive improvements in safety, quality, production, and cost. Requisitos Required Skills And Experience Minimum 3 years’ experience in manufacturing and/or equipment role. Good analytical and problem-solving skills. English 80% read, written, and spoken. Manufacturing process experience includes equipment experience, support and troubleshooting. Strong communication skills, both written and verbal. Necessary to engage with technicians, production management, product development, planning, purchasing and different organizations across the company. Knowledge and execution of Good Manufacturing Practices (GMP). Knowledge and experience in the use of special mechanical, electronics, and measuring equipment. Experienced in ISO 13485, or medical device manufacturing environment. Experience with Microsoft Office, SAP, Agile programs. Required Education And Training Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering, electronics engineering, mechatronic engineering, industrial engineering or similar preferred. Travel: Position may require 5% travel, primarily within the United States. Preferred Skills And Experience Experienced in ISO 13485, or medical device manufacturing environment is a plus. Prior experience with Documentation and production control systems: Agile, SAP, MES. Experience supporting engineering change control activities, including ECOs and related change orders (BCOs, NCOs, MCOs, etc.). Proven ability to create, update, and manage manufacturing work instructions (e.g., MPIs, IPCs). Familiarity with quality notifications processes, such as VRs, NCRs, PLs, and related workflows. Experience monitoring and reporting equipment performance, including downtime tracking, event reporting, and coordination with MRP system transactions or status updates. Información adicional Intuitive es un empleador que brinda igualdad de oportunidades de empleo. Proporcionamos igualdad de oportunidades de empleo a todos los solicitantes y empleados cualificados, y prohibimos cualquier tipo de discriminación y acoso, independientemente de su raza, sexo, condición de embarazo, orientación sexual, identidad de género, origen nacional, color, edad, religión, condición de veterano protegido o de discapacidad, información genética o cualquier otra condición protegida por las leyes federales, estatales o locales aplicables. Aviso sobre los Controles de Exportación de EE. UU.: De acuerdo con las Regulaciones de Administración de Exportaciones de EE. UU. (15 CFR 743.13(b)), algunos puestos en Intuitive Surgical pueden estar sujetos a controles de exportación de EE. UU. para candidatos que sean nacionales de países actualmente bajo embargo o sanciones. Cierta información que usted proporcione como parte de la solicitud será utilizada para determinar si Intuitive Surgical necesitará (i) obtener una licencia de exportación del gobierno de EE. UU. en su nombre (nota: el proceso de obtención de la licencia puede tardar entre 3 y más de 6 meses) o (ii) implementar un Plan de Control de Tecnología (“TCP”, por sus siglas en inglés) (nota: normalmente este paso agrega 2 semanas al proceso de contratación). Para cualquier puesto en Intuitive sujeto a controles de exportación, las ofertas finales están condicionadas a la obtención de una licencia de exportación aprobada y/o a la ejecución de un TCP antes de la fecha de inicio del empleado potencial, la cual puede o no ser flexible, y dentro de un plazo que no obstaculice de manera irrazonable la necesidad de contratación. Si aplica, los candidatos serán notificados e instruidos sobre cualquier requisito relacionado con estos fines. Este puesto puede cubrirse con un nivel de puesto diferente al indicado aquí, según las necesidades del negocio y/o la experiencia, los conocimientos y las habilidades del candidato o la candidata seleccionado. La compensación se basará principalmente en el nivel del puesto en el que se cubra el rol y en las cualificaciones del candidato o la candidata, de conformidad con la legislación aplicable. Shift: Day
